evidence.value: Indian startup Green Collar Agritech Solutions creates crop growth analytics utilizing machine learning and AI to increase agricultural production.
evidence.quote: Indian startup Green Collar Agritech Solutions creates crop growth analytics utilizing machine learning and AI to increase agricultural production. It provides real-time insights about crop health and growth patterns by analyzing large datasets from multiple sources, such as sensor data and satellite photography. The startup’s TARAM is a portable AI-powered device for instant, on-site quality analysis of spices and high-value crops. The TARAM-IQ platform aggregates and analyzes data on quality, quantity, and location to support better decision-making in the agricultural value chain. This way, Green Collar Agritech Solutions provides farmers with useful information that raises the caliber of agricultural products, encourages sustainable farming methods, and boosts food security. 2. Abit Founding Year : 2022 Location : Milan, Italy Use For : Functional Biodiversity Management Software Italian startup Abit offers biodiversity management tools for farmers to preserve the ecological balance of agricultural systems. The startup’s platform utilizes AI to analyze biodiversity data and forecast how different agricultural methods affect the health of ecosystems. It provides information on crop diversity, pest management, and soil health by combining real-time analytics with biodiversity measures. This enables farmers to implement more environmentally friendly methods. The main advantages of this platform include improved decision-making skills, increased crop resistance to pests and diseases, and resource efficiency. 3. Yevul Info Founding Year : 2022 Location : Katzrin, Israel Use For : AI-enhanced Plant Health Detection
